A sample post carrying valid Article structured data

By Fixture Author, Clean Fixture Site. Published 2026-09-01, last updated 2026-09-01.

A short example post used to exercise Article structured data validation, heading order, and internal linking checks in the siteseo test suite. Every fact in the markup above also appears here in the body, which is exactly what the structured data policy asks for.

Why the facts must match

Structured data that describes content a reader cannot see is a policy violation rather than a shortcut. The headline, the description, the author name, the publisher name and both dates are all printed on this page, so the validator has something to match them against.

What this page exercises

It carries one h1, headings that descend without skipping a level, a self-referencing canonical, an image that declares its dimensions, and a link back to the home page so nothing here is orphaned.
